verses.1: A hymn for David, my king. May the Lord, your God, bless your name forever and ever.
verses.2: Every day, we bless and praise your name forever and ever.
verses.3: God is great and greatly praised; there is no limit to His greatness.
verses.4: From generation to generation, they will praise your deeds and your achievements.
verses.5: May your glory be praised, and may the words of your greatness be remembered forever.
verses.6: And those who see your glory will say, “Your greatness is indeed great!”
verses.7: May their remembrance of your great goodness be a reminder to them, and may your righteousness bless us.
verses.8: May Jehovah’s kindness and mercy extend to us, and may His grace be everlasting.
verses.9: May the Lord be good to all, and may His mercy be upon all His creations.
verses.10: May the LORD bless all your deeds and your followers.
verses.11: May your kingdom be praised, and may your power be known throughout the world.
verses.12: To inform the children of men about the glory of their king and the honor of his reign.
verses.13: Your kingdom is the kingdom of all worlds. You rule over everything in every age.
verses.14: May the LORD comfort all those who are fallen, and heal all those who are wounded.
verses.15: The eyes of all those who belong to you will be satisfied, and you will allow them to eat at that time.
verses.16: Open your hand and grant every living being its desires.
verses.17: The Lord is righteous in all His ways, and He is faithful in all His actions.
verses.18: The Lord is close to all those who call upon Him, to all who truly seek His help.
verses.19: His desires will be fulfilled, and he will hear their pleas and save them.
verses.20: The LORD will remember all His lovers, and He will destroy all the wicked.
verses.21: The voice of Jehovah will speak through me, and He will bless all those who are holy in His sight, forever and ever.
